def find_Parity(x):
    """Write a python function to find the parity of a given number.

    The parity is even when the binary representation of the number
    contains an even number of set (1) bits, and odd otherwise.
    """
    return "Odd Parity" if bin(abs(x)).count("1") % 2 else "Even Parity"
